title: Code Division Multiple Access Spreading and Despreading
aim: Demonstrate direct-sequence CDMA by spreading three users' data with orthogonal Walsh codes and recovering the data at the receiver.
parameters: Three users with four data bits each
BPSK mapping: bit 1 to +1 and bit 0 to -1
method: Spread each BPSK symbol by multiplying it by the user's Walsh code. Add all user chip streams to form the composite signal. At the receiver, correlate the composite signal with each user code, divide by four, and make a sign-based bit decision.
result: All three users' transmitted bits are recovered exactly. Orthogonal Walsh codes separate the simultaneous user data in the noiseless simulation.
